sessions.name: A
prompts: Run the ledgerlite unit tests and get them running correctly. Tell me the exact command that works.

sessions.name: B
prompts: Add a Ledger.close(name) method that refuses to close an account whose balance is not zero (raise ValueError), add a unit test for it, and make sure the whole test suite passes.

exact_observations: `python -m unittest` from the project root ran 0 tests (exit 5).
`python -m unittest discover -s tests` failed with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'ledgerlite'.
`PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests` ran the suite successfully.

supported_lessons.proposition: Run the ledgerlite tests with `PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests` from the project root.
Without PYTHONPATH=src the src-layout package is not importable from tests; plain discovery fails or runs nothing.
supported_lessons.retry_condition: Retry plain discovery if the package becomes installed or tests add src to sys.path.

acceptable_uncertainty: Whether installing the package in editable mode would also work was not tested.
